statement: Every actual nontrivial intrinsic line or circle boundary quotient of C42 has plane or annulus source. Explicit coordinate changes retaining the real target lift give the five map normal forms in C44.1, with whole fibres, component labels, source covering restrictions, and the actual induced fundamental-group image recorded.
depends_on: C42 exact source and target covering maps; C43 global product retaining F; free proper deck action; the explicit nearest-neighbor argument for a free proper group on a line
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b) infinite-operator request; exact quotient and covering constraints in the remaining frontier-extension problem
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The deck shift is defined by the actual identity F gamma = F + eta(gamma). Its kernel is proved cyclic or trivial by restriction to one real fibre. Every subsequent normalization is written explicitly and preserves F.
notes: The kernel of the actual deck-shift homomorphism acts freely and properly on each real fibre and is trivial or Z. In the cyclic-kernel case the variable fundamental intervals give a continuous global conjugacy to unit fibre translation. A simultaneous nonzero base shift would make the source the image of a compact cylinder strip, contradicting openness in the plane. With trivial kernel and shift image mZ, interpolation between identity and h_0 followed by the exact recursion rho_(t+m)=h_t rho_t conjugates the deck generator to pure base translation. The component labels for a circle target are Z/eta(Gamma), with each component R/K; a line target has one component R/K. All restricted covering maps are thereby proved onto their displayed components. This treats one quotient at a time and does not assert compatibility among multiple boundary maps or solve C12.
